description: Get Inbox Threads - Retrieve inbox threads with optional filtering. Note: only type, sequence, search, date, sender, limit, and skip are applied by the API.

limit.description: Maximum number of threads to return (default: 10, max 100)

search.description: Search in body, subject, or email address

skip.description: Number of threads to skip for pagination (default: 0)

type.description: Type of threads to retrieve. When omitted, replies are returned (the default).

workspace_id.description: Workspace ID this action applies to. When omitted, the current or default workspace is used.

name: get_inbox_threads

result.description: The raw result returned by the SalesBlink tool.

title: Get Inbox Threads
